> ⚠️ **This is a beta.** Every change passes the automated tests on Linux, macOS, Windows and Android, but this build hasn't been tested on real devices yet. Want the proven version? Stay on [v0.7.0](https://github.com/flowerpower584/fluxsync/releases/tag/v0.7.0). Found something odd? [Tell us](https://github.com/flowerpower584/fluxsync/issues/new).

**FluxSync copies on one device and pastes on another — over your own Wi-Fi, end-to-end encrypted, no account, no cloud.**

## What's new: copy on your phone, paste on your computer — no tap

Until now, a copy made on the phone often didn't leave it unless you opened FluxSync. That's Android's rule since Android 10: only the app in front can read the clipboard.

FluxSync now notices **that you just copied** — a "Copy" button, a "Copied" message, or the clipboard bubble on Android 13+ and Samsung phones — and reads the clipboard **the way Android allows**: by showing an invisible FluxSync screen for a fraction of a second. Your copy goes to your computer with no button to press. Android 12+ shows its usual "FluxSync pasted from your clipboard" notice when that happens; that's expected.

- Needs the **Accessibility** setting on (as before). [What it does and doesn't do](https://github.com/flowerpower584/fluxsync/blob/main/docs/WHY-ACCESSIBILITY.md).
- **Xiaomi / Redmi / POCO:** allow FluxSync to *show pop-up windows while running in the background* (Settings → Apps → FluxSync → Other permissions).
- Copies from your computer already arrive on the phone by themselves; nothing changes there.
- The **Send clipboard** button, tile and **Share → FluxSync** are still there for anything that slips through.

## Download

| Device | File to download |
|---|---|
| **Android** (phone or tablet) | `FluxSync-v0.8.0-beta.4-arm64-v8a.apk` |
| **Mac with Apple chip** (M1, M2, M3…) | the `.zip` ending in `_aarch64.zip` |
| **Mac with Intel chip** | the `.zip` ending in `_x64.zip` |
| **Windows** (most PCs) | the file ending in `_x64-setup.exe` |
| **Windows on ARM** | the file ending in `_arm64-setup.exe` |
| **Linux** (Ubuntu, Debian…) | the `.deb` file |
| **Linux** (any distribution) | the `.AppImage` file |

The [README](https://github.com/flowerpower584/fluxsync#readme) walks through installing and pairing, step by step.

**Upgrading:** install over your current version; pairings and history are kept.
